name: Foreverse
tagline: Foreverse is a free Android AI novel reader with SillyTavern-compatible character chat
description: Foreverse is a free Android AI novel reader with SillyTavern-compatible character chat. What it does Import your own TXT/EPUB novels, select any paragraph to continue, rewrite or expand - every continuation comes with plot candidates, and picking a different one forks the book into a new branch while the original stays intact. Chat spoiler-free with characters from your books: they only know what you have read so far. Key benefits - Deep SillyTavern compatibility: PNG/JSON/charx cards, lorebooks
